ترتشوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَشُوا (tartašū) /tar.ta.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# تُرْتَشَوْا (turtašaw) /tur.ta.ʃaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
